description: This file defines the MenuContextCardInjector class, a singleton responsible for injecting a custom SwiftUI view into an AppKit NSMenu as a menu item. It manages the lifecycle of cached session data, responds to menu events to display dynamic content, and interacts with session loading logic. The class bridges SwiftUI and AppKit to provide a custom menu experience with session context cards.

classes.name: MenuContextCardInjector
classes.description: A singleton class that injects a SwiftUI view into an NSMenu as a context card, manages cache of session data, and handles menu lifecycle events.

methods.name: install(into:)
methods.description: Sets up the injector into a given NSStatusItem, attaching itself as the menu delegate and warming up cache.

methods.name: menuWillOpen(_:)
methods.description: Handles actions needed when the menu is about to open, including injecting the context card view and starting cache refresh tasks.

methods.name: menuDidClose(_:)
methods.description: Handles cleanup after the menu closes, cancelling ongoing tasks.

methods.name: menuNeedsUpdate(_:)
methods.description: Delegates menu update notifications to the original delegate.

methods.name: confinementRect(for:on:)
methods.description: Provides confinement rectangle for menu positioning, deferring to original delegate if available.

methods.name: refreshCache(force:)
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes session cache, updating state or setting error text on failure.

methods.name: cachedView()
methods.description: Returns the current cached SwiftUI view representing the session context card.

methods.name: loadCurrentRows()
methods.description: Fetches and filters current session rows based on activity window.

methods.name: findInsertIndex(in:)
methods.description: Determines the position at which to insert the custom menu item.

methods.name: initialCardWidth(for:)
methods.description: Calculates initial width for the context card view based on menu and previous cache.

methods.name: captureMenuWidthIfAvailable(for:hosting:)
methods.description: Attempts to measure and cache menu width for consistent sizing.
